text:
Predicates:
Likes(x, y) ::: x likes y.
Composes(x) ::: x composes.
HasAccess(x, y) ::: x has access to y.
Program(x) ::: x is a program.
Premises:
Likes(george, music) → Composes(george) ::: If George likes music, he wants to compose.
HasAccess(george, program) → Composes(george) ::: If George has access to a program, he can compose.
(Composes(george) ∧ Likes(george, compose)) → Composes(george) ::: If George can compose and wants to compose, he will compose.
Conclusion:
(Likes(george, music) ∧ HasAccess(george, program)) → Composes(george) ::: If George likes music and has access to a program, he will compose.
